title: $100 a month into Nike since 1990 is now worth this
caption:
$100 every month into Nike since 1990.
Today that would be worth about {dca:NKE:1990-01-02} (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: Could you put away $100 a month? 👇
sources: Nike price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: One hundred dollars a month, into Nike, starting in 1990.
Back then, Nike was a shoe company.
Today, those monthly payments would be worth about {dca:NKE:1990-01-02}.
Small, boring, every month. That's how wealth is built.
